basics.description: **Sentinel content for Abstract data: rules and workbooks** Abstract Security: a security data pipeline and agentic SIEM in one platform. A self-contained approximation of the Abstract Microsoft Sentinel solution that installs connector tiles, an ASIM parser function, analytics and automation rules, hunting queries, workbooks and playbooks into an existing Sentinel workspace. Sufficient for a lab or private install; not a substitute for the certified Content Hub package.

metadata.hidden: Hiding location, we get it from the log analytics workspace

basics.name: workspace
basics.label: Workspace name
basics.toolTip: Name of the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is enabled and where the Abstract custom table (AbstractEventLogs_CL) lives.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the existing workspace name (4-63 chars).

options.text: Questions or help with this deployment: email support@abstract.security or use the contact page at https://www.abstract.security/contact-us.

Installs two scheduled analytics rules — 'Abstract - High or Critical event' (surfaces AbstractInsightId for the Verdict playbook) and 'Abstract - Repeated auth failures followed by success' (brute-force / password-spray) — the ASim_AbstractEvent parser, and two hunting queries (rare product, high cumulative-risk identities).
Installs the Abstract Security data connector tile (live ingestion-status graph) and the Pipeline Overview workbook (volume, coverage, and a reduction/cost estimate).

This wizard installs the in-workspace content (connector tile, workbook, analytics, hunts, playbooks). Deploy the Abstract ingestion stack (Data Collection Endpoint + Data Collection Rule + AbstractEventLogs_CL) separately with the Sentinel Destination template — the one-click 'Deploy to Azure' variant in the solution repo provisions the DCE and DCR this connector and workbook read from.

Enterprise prerequisite — Entra app registration (RBAC): Abstract publishes events to the Sentinel DCR through an Entra ID app registration and its service principal. Azure Resource Manager cannot create the app registration, so create it in Entra ID first, then grant its service principal 'Monitoring Metrics Publisher' on the Data Collection Rule only — not the subscription or resource group. That is all the Logs Ingestion API needs: the identity can publish to that rule and nothing else. Do not add Monitoring Contributor unless your Abstract setup asks for it; it would let a leaked credential rewrite or delete the rule. Store the client secret in Azure Key Vault.

Installs three Logic App playbooks — Enrich Incident, Verdict (agentic), and Tune-at-source — that call the Abstract API to close the loop. Provide the Abstract API settings below to wire them up now, or leave them blank and configure them after install. The Security Copilot plugin/agent ship in the solution source (solution/copilot).

elements.name: abstractBaseUrl
elements.label: Abstract API base URL
elements.toolTip: Abstract API base URL the playbooks call.

elements.name: abstractVendorAccountId
elements.label: Abstract vendor account id (optional)
elements.toolTip: Sent as the x-as-vendor-account-id header. Leave blank to configure later.

elements.name: keyVaultSecretUri
elements.label: Key Vault secret URI for the Abstract API key (optional)
elements.toolTip: The URI of a Key Vault secret that already holds the Abstract API key, for example https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/abstract-api-key. Each playbook reads it at run time through its managed identity. Leave blank to install the playbooks without it.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a Key Vault secret URI such as https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/<name>, or leave this blank.

options.text: The API key itself is never entered in this wizard and is never stored in the template. First store it as a secret in Azure Key Vault, then paste that secret's URI above and grant each playbook's managed identity the Key Vault Secrets User role on it. If you leave the URI blank the playbooks install but fail until it is set. After install, authorize each playbook's Microsoft Sentinel API connection and attach the playbooks via automation rules.
